research_notes: Follow up full-time status and breaks across all paid work; identify café and Melbourne broadcast employers, 2HD start and 2NURFM dates/pay status; establish 1993–1997 HROC/Hunter Tourism legal employer control.

2026-09-29 searches covered APH biography and handbooks, personal biography/first-speech index, Radio Today/RadioInfo 2013 departure, employer 2NURFM election report, ABC election guides, HROC historical timeline, university governance and public professional-profile leads. Targeted full-time searches yielded unrelated jobs/policies, not her work hours.

Do not carry present Hunter JO structure back to 1993. 2024 primary timeline locates later incorporation in 2002 and commercial company in 2003–04. Historical constitution/annual reports remain a better avenue for period control. Hunter Tourism could be industry/nonprofit or council-associated; funding alone does not decide.

Café Delish is an unverified lead from reporting about her spouse, not a verified employer or dates for her. RadioInfo says employment scheduled to expire 20 December 2013 while Radio Today describes earlier on-air departure on 13 December; retain month until contractual end clarified. On-air hours are not total working hours. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; all aggregate/subspell overlaps are non-additive.
